text:
sam-cs: Heads up — new customer sent a promo and their mobile app rollout triggered tons of SDK inits. We're seeing 401s intermittently and a steady stream of 429s during the first 2 minutes of the campaign.
sam-cs: Logs from the integration: "[2026-07-08T09:02:12Z] preflight 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
[2026-07-08T09:02:12Z] auth 401 token-verify failed: clock-skew"

li-dev: Are they minting ephemeral tokens per device on every cold-start? That pattern can hammer preflight.

sam-cs: Yes, per device on boot. They do parallel token fetch + immediate init across many workers.

jamie-sre: Looks like a twofold issue: stampede on preflight + auth failures from skewed client clocks. Quick mitigations: bump onboarding burst for the account, add a server-side short TTL cache for recent preflight results, and recommend client-side jitter + bounded concurrency.

devex-bot: PR template: add initQueue helper to mobile SDK to coalesce concurrent inits. Example API: `SDK.initQueue(token, { maxConcurrent: 8, jitterMs: 2000 })`.

li-dev: Sample client guidance we can give them: limit concurrent inits to N (8-12), add randomized backoff for token fetch, and if using ephemeral tokens, try to fetch once per app-start and reuse across tabs/threads. Pseudocode:
```js
// client-side init queue (pseudocode)
const q = new InitQueue({maxConcurrent:8, jitter:()=>Math.random()*1500});
q.enqueue(async () => {
  const token = await fetchToken();
  await sdk.init({token});
});
```

sam-cs: We pushed those suggestions. They also reported some devices have incorrect time settings. What do we recommend for token validation to be tolerant?

jamie-sre: Server-side: allow a small clock skew window (+/- 2 minutes) when validating ephemeral JWTs for onboarding traffic, and log collisions. Also add a metric for token-mint-rate per account so we can alert on spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Temporarily raised onboarding burst for acct-promo-456 by +40 req/s until 2026-07-09T12:00Z. Incident ref: INC-2026-0567.

li-dev: Another short-term trick: let the auth service return a short-lived refresh token for the device that can be reused for a few minutes instead of re-minting a brand-new ephemeral token on every worker. That collapses churn.

sam-cs: After applying client-side queue + jitter they saw improvement: "[2026-07-08T09:05:03Z] preflight ok 200 X-RateLimit-Remaining: 62
[2026-07-08T09:05:03Z] init ok 200 token-exchange"

sam-cs: Residual 401s dropped to near 0.5% and 429s effectively stopped.

jamie-sre: Follow-ups: 1) Devex to add initQueue helper to mobile SDK and docs sample. 2) CS to include checklist item about device clock validation in onboarding playbook. 3) SRE to keep burst change until tomorrow and produce metric dashboard for token-mint-rate.

devex-bot: Filed SDK issue #422: addInitQueue and sample snippet.

sam-cs: I'll send the customer a short doc we can paste into their rollout checklist. Thanks team! :tada:
